sources.title: Ebenezer Flats Flood Mitigation Study - Roads and Driveways, 1.0 m Raise
sources.location: Columbia Street, 22nd Avenue and 25 driveways, Ebenezer Flats near Smithers, BC
sources.cost_year_basis: Itemized estimate explicitly dated November 29, 2018; report published March 2019. Not 2019 or 2026 rates.
sources.source_locator: Appendix C, Class D Cost Estimate - Roads and Driveways (1.0m Raise), estimate pages 1-2; PDF pages 90-91.
sources.scope: Raise 1,300 m existing paved roadway and reconstruct 25 driveways for flood protection. Remove pavement, add 0.4 m fill and 0.615 m pavement structure over existing granulars; reconstruct ditches both sides. Driveways assumed 6 m x 14.5 m and ~7% grade. Not new forest-road construction.

basis.engineering: 6% engineering and construction services on subtotal
basis.environmental: 2% environmental mitigation, in addition to $20,000 erosion/sediment-control construction item
basis.traffic: $115,000 traffic control; 60-day window using 1 m wide, 0.3 m deep gravel widening along existing 1.3 km road
exclusions: Streetlighting, signage and pavement-marking installations, reinstatements or relocations
basis.haul: Common excavation explicitly includes offsite disposal; haul distance not stated

quality_flags: Historical 2018 prices; do not silently inflate or relabel as current.
Imported embankment fill is $65/tonne; CBC and SGSB are $65/m3. Same numeric price, different units.
Driveway culvert diameter/material/depth not specified in estimate, so $500/m is contextual only.
